terms.title: Booking Terms and Conditions
terms.lead: The conditions that apply when searching, paying and staying through PortoBreak.

sections.title: 1. The portal and how to contact us
paragraphs: PortoBreak is operated by {company_name}, tax identification number {tax_id}, with its registered office at {address}. For questions about a booking, contact {contact_email} and include your booking reference.

sections.title: 2. Booking requests and confirmation
paragraphs: Before proceeding, check the property, dates, number and age groups of guests, price and your contact details. You can book as a guest or create an account.

Submitting your details starts a booking request and takes you to payment. The booking is confirmed once payment has been validated and a confirmation with the booking reference has been issued. Starting a request or leaving a payment incomplete does not constitute a confirmed booking.

If you are charged but do not receive confirmation, contact us with the reference and proof of payment, without sending full card details. Our team will investigate; if the accommodation cannot be provided, the refund due will be arranged, without affecting any other legal rights.

sections.title: 3. Price and payment
paragraphs: The summary shown before payment identifies the price in euros, the nights and itemised charges, including cleaning and tourist tax where applicable. Check the total amount before paying. Prices shown without dates are indicative.

Payment is processed through Stripe Checkout. PortoBreak receives transaction references and status information; full card details are entered in Stripe's payment environment. Do not send card details by email.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation, refunds and no-shows
paragraphs: Cancellation deadlines are calculated using the date and time in mainland Portugal, relative to the check-in date. The refund percentage applies to the amount paid for the booking, subject to any applicable mandatory legal provisions.
bullets: A 100% refund if the request is received before 00:00 on the tenth day before check-in. The last full day for free cancellation is therefore the eleventh day before arrival.
A 50% refund from 00:00 on the tenth day before check-in until 23:59 on the day before arrival.
No refund from 00:00 on the check-in date, including no-shows and requests made afterwards.

links.label: View the Cancellation Policy and date examples

sections.title: 5. How to request a cancellation or change
paragraphs: Send your request to {contact_email}, preferably from the email address used for the booking, with your reference and the change you would like to make. The applicable refund tier is determined by the date and time the request is received, not when the team replies.

A change of dates, property or guests is subject to availability, the applicable price and written confirmation. Refunds due are handled by the team; the time it takes for the funds to become available also depends on the payment provider and bank.

sections.title: 6. Check-in, check-out and use of the property
paragraphs: Please observe the capacity limit and specific rules communicated for the property. Check-in and check-out times and access instructions are provided as part of the confirmed booking. Guests must provide the identification details legally required for their stay.

The booking holder must ensure that other guests are aware of the house rules, respect neighbours and promptly report incidents or damage. Any liability for damage will be assessed on the facts and under applicable law; these terms do not authorise automatic charges for unsubstantiated amounts.

sections.title: 7. Problems during your stay
paragraphs: Please report any problem as soon as you notice it so that it can be investigated and resolved. If a confirmed property becomes unavailable, the team will contact the guest to explore a solution; any alternative requires your acceptance. If the service cannot be provided, the refund due will be arranged, without affecting your statutory rights.

sections.title: 8. Bookings for specific dates
paragraphs: Accommodation services for non-residential purposes with a specific date or period of performance fall within the exception to the 14-day right of withdrawal set out in Article 17(1)(k) of Portuguese Decree-Law No. 24/2014. The cancellation and refund rights defined in these conditions and the consumer's other statutory rights remain unaffected.

sections.title: 9. Complaints, applicable law and documents
paragraphs: You can make a complaint using our support contact or the Electronic Complaints Book. The Legal Information page lists support and alternative dispute resolution channels.

Portuguese law applies, without excluding any applicable mandatory consumer protection provisions or access to the competent courts. Future changes to these terms will not alter the conditions of bookings already confirmed without a legal basis or the customer's agreement. Keep the confirmation and the conditions applicable to your booking.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: The data used for your booking, why it is used and how you can exercise your rights.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: {company_name}, tax identification number {tax_id}, with its registered office at {address}, is the controller of personal data collected through the PortoBreak portal. For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, contact {contact_email} and identify your request as a data protection matter.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
paragraphs: The booking form asks for your name, email address and country. You can also provide your telephone number, address, tax identification number and comments. We process dates, property details, the number of adults, children and infants, amounts, references, and booking and payment statuses.

If you create an account, we process profile data, a hash of your password and the information needed for email verification and account recovery. We also process support communications, IP addresses, browser information and technical logs associated with the use and security of the service.

Additional guest identification details may be requested at check-in to meet legal accommodation requirements. Avoid including health information or other sensitive data in the comments field; contact the team if you need to explain a specific requirement.

sections.title: 2.1. Usage statistics and traffic sources
paragraphs: The portal maintains aggregate page-request counts by hour, page, search category, device, estimated connection country or referring domain. These use no analytics cookies, visitor or session identifiers, or browser fingerprinting. They cannot follow an individual or measure unique visitors.

Only with permission for “Usage statistics”, our own analytics uses random pseudonymous visitor and session identifiers. These measure pages and properties viewed, referring domains and permitted campaign parameters, search dates and guest numbers, booking steps and estimated active time. An internal reference may link the session to a completed booking to count conversions, without copying personal booking information or payment data into analytics.

Device, browser, operating system and language categories are recorded. Country is used only when estimated by a trusted proxy from the IP address: it is not nationality or an exact location, and remains unknown without a reliable source. Active time is an estimate which may be incomplete, not an exact stopwatch.

The analytics module does not store raw IP addresses, the full User-Agent, free-text searches, personal form contents, payment data, tokens or URLs containing sensitive parameters. We neither infer nor collect gender or age ranges; those fields remain unknown. These limits do not change the separate records needed for bookings and security described above.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Processing needed for your booking does not depend on a general marketing consent.
bullets: Preparing requests and managing bookings, payments, cancellations, accounts and support: taking steps at your request before entering into a contract and performing the contract.
Invoicing, tax obligations, guest records and responses to authorities: compliance with applicable legal obligations.
Protecting accounts, preventing misuse, resolving incidents and defending rights: legitimate interests in the security and protection of the service, balanced against individuals' rights.

Remembering language, loading external maps and measuring usage with pseudonymous identifiers: consent, requested separately for each purpose and which you can withdraw using ‘Manage cookies’, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. You can search and book without allowing them. Aggregate counts without cookies or identifiers do not create visitor profiles. Any promotional communications require a separate choice.

sections.title: 4. Required data and decisions
paragraphs: Fields marked as required are needed to prepare the booking and send confirmation. Without that information, it may not be possible to complete the request. Creating an account is not required to book.

Availability and prices are calculated from the dates and guests you enter. You can contact the team to clarify a result or request a review of a situation. Payment checks carried out by Stripe are described in its privacy policy.

sections.title: 5. Who receives your data
paragraphs: Data needed to operate the service is accessible to the team managing bookings and stays. Internal notifications may include booking details so the team can follow up and support guests.

We use providers of hosting, maintenance, email and payment processing services. Stripe processes the data needed for payment and fraud prevention. Where necessary, data may be disclosed to accountants, advisers and authorities in the course of their respective duties and legal obligations.

sections.title: 6. External services and international transfers
paragraphs: OpenStreetMap maps are loaded only after you allow the external maps category. When enabled, your browser sends your IP address, browser information and technical request data to the map service. You can withdraw this permission using ‘Manage cookies’ in the footer. Property images may be served from szeroapp.com, a domain used to operate the portal, which receives the technical data needed to deliver the images. Fonts and the map library are hosted by the portal, without requests to Google Fonts or unpkg.

Payment takes place on Stripe's hosted checkout, which has its own privacy information. Using international service providers may involve processing data outside the European Economic Area. Transfers are subject to GDPR requirements, including an applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, as relevant. You can request information about the relevant recipients, countries and safeguards through the privacy contact. Stripe's policy describes the mechanisms used by that provider.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
paragraphs: Retention periods are determined by the purpose and applicable obligations: managing bookings and outstanding requests; maintaining the account while needed for the service; statutory retention periods for tax and accommodation records; and the periods needed to resolve complaints or defend legal rights.

Requests for erasure are assessed against these criteria. Where the law requires certain documents to be retained, deleting an account does not mean those documents can be deleted immediately. You can request the specific periods or criteria applicable to your data. Cookie lifetimes are listed in the Cookie Policy.

The reference retention periods are 90 days for analytics events and sessions and 180 days for aggregate counts without visitor or session identifiers. The random visitor identifier and last-activity date become eligible for cleanup after 180 days of inactivity. Automatic cleanup periodically deletes records exceeding these periods while the portal is in use; if the portal is inactive, cleanup resumes on its next use. Withdrawing consent stops new events linked to visitors and sessions and deletes analytics cookies; earlier data remains subject to this cleanup and your rights. Cookie lifetimes are separate.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to the conditions and limits of the GDPR, you can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of your data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time.

Send your request to {contact_email}. We may ask for the information strictly necessary to confirm your identity and protect your data. We normally reply within one month; any legally permitted extension will be communicated with the reasons for it.
You can lodge a complaint with the Portuguese Data Protection Authority (CNPD), without affecting other administrative or judicial remedies.

sections.title: 9. Security and updates
paragraphs: Keep your password and booking access links secure. Do not share references, documents or personal links publicly. Contact the team if you suspect unauthorised access.
This policy may be updated when the service or applicable obligations change. The published date and version identify the current text.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.lead: Information about browser storage and the external services used by the portal.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored by your browser that help maintain a session or remember a preference. They may be session cookies, linked to your browser session, or persistent cookies with a defined lifetime.

sections.title: 2. The portal's own cookies
paragraphs: Necessary cookies support the features being used and store your choices. Language and analytics cookies are optional and require permission for their respective category:

rows: {session_cookie_name}
Maintain the session, account access and permission to view payment details. Required for the features being used.

sections.title: 2.1. Our own analytics
paragraphs: Analytics is operated by PortoBreak, without Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or third-party advertising. Without permission, there are only aggregate page-request counts, without analytics cookies, visitor or session identifiers, or fingerprinting.

With “Usage statistics”, optional cookies allow pseudonymous visitor and session counts, referring domains and permitted campaign parameters, searched dates and guest composition, pages, booking steps and completion. Active time is only estimated. Analytics does not collect free-text searches, personal form contents, payment data, tokens or sensitive URLs, and does not store raw IP addresses or the full User-Agent.

Country is used only when estimated by a trusted proxy; it does not mean nationality. Gender and age ranges are neither inferred nor collected. Automatic cleanup removes events and sessions older than 90 days, aggregates without identifiers older than 180 days, and visitor identifiers after 180 days of inactivity. Cleanup runs periodically while the portal is in use; following portal inactivity, it resumes on the next use. See the Privacy Policy for more information.

sections.title: 3. Payment and external content
paragraphs: Payment opens Stripe's hosted checkout, which has its own cookies and privacy rules. Your choices on this portal do not control cookies in that payment environment. Please read the information provided by Stripe.

External maps use OpenStreetMap images and are loaded only with your permission. These requests may send your IP address, browser information and technical data to the map service, even when no cookies are set. Permission for maps is independent of the language preference.

The Inter fonts and Leaflet library are served by the portal itself, without connections to Google Fonts or unpkg. Property photographs may load from szeroapp.com, a domain used by the portal's operator to serve images; these requests transmit the technical data needed to deliver them.

sections.title: 4. Your choices
paragraphs: On your first visit you can accept optional features, reject them or choose language, external maps and usage statistics separately. All three categories are off until you decide. An older permission without the analytics category does not enable it. Necessary cookies remain active and you can search and book without optional features. You can always change language through portal links without saving a preference.

You can change or withdraw permission at any time using ‘Manage cookies’ in the footer. Disabling preferences deletes the language cookie; disabling maps removes open maps and stops new map requests; disabling statistics deletes analytics cookies and stops new events linked to visitors and sessions. Withdrawal does not undo requests already sent or affect the lawfulness of earlier processing.

You can also view and delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies may prevent access to your account or payment steps. If you delete the choice record, or when it expires, the portal asks you to decide again and keeps optional features off until you do.
We do not use third-party advertising. New optional purposes require updated information and choices before they are used.

sections.title: 5. Privacy and contact
paragraphs: For questions about cookies and personal data, contact {contact_email}. The Privacy Policy identifies the controller, the purposes of processing and your rights.

legal.title: Legal Information and Consumer Support
legal.lead: The identity of PortoBreak's operator and channels for support, complaints and dispute resolution.

sections.title: 1. Operator details
paragraphs: Portal trading name: PortoBreak.
Entity: {company_name}
Tax identification number: {tax_id}.
Registered office: {address}.
Support and privacy contact: {contact_email}.

sections.title: 2. Support and complaints
paragraphs: For questions about a booking, include your reference and the email address used. You can use the Electronic Complaints Book without first submitting a complaint to the support team.

sections.title: 3. Alternative dispute resolution
paragraphs: For consumer disputes relating to services covered in the Porto Metropolitan Area, you can contact CICAP — Centro de Informação de Consumo e Arbitragem do Porto, within its jurisdiction. Contact details: Rua Damião de Góis, 31, Loja 6, 4050-225 Porto; cicap@cicap.pt.

The competent body depends on the location and subject of the dispute. You can consult the recognised bodies through the Portuguese Directorate-General for Consumer Affairs. This information does not constitute a declaration that the company has voluntarily joined CICAP and does not affect cases where arbitration is required by law or recourse to the courts.

links.label: Alternative dispute resolution bodies — Directorate-General for Consumer Affairs
